newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palmoil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival.
The markets reopen on April 21. On Thursday, prices ended a shortened week higher on short-covering despite overnight falls in Chicago soyoil futures and a poor fundamental outlook.
A trader said: "We expect further range-trading next week unless there are fresh developments in the market."
Players will be waiting for news from the third annual Asia Pacific Vegetable Oilseeds and Meals Market Conference next week in Kuala Lumpur, traders said.
